description: This file defines a class 'MobileAppTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages the table display, actions, and data fetching for mobile applications within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for setting up columns, handling delete actions, and rendering status indicators.

classes.name: MobileAppTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides configuration for the mobile applications table, including columns, actions, and data operations.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for mobile apps.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up the cell action descriptors, primarily the delete action.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a mobile app, opening a confirmation dialog if the app is published.

methods.name: mobileStatus
methods.description: Generates an HTML string representing the status badge with appropriate color and label.

methods.name: mobileStatusStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for status text color based on app status.
